anchor_note: Anchor prices captured 2026-08-19 between 12:10 and 12:30 ET from yfinance live quotes. Cohort A's anchor is the CONFIRMED STOP FILL from trades.json (email_confirmed), not the anchor price -- scoring a stop against anything other than where it actually filled would flatter or punish it unfairly. Cohort B and C anchor at the price when proposed / when filled respectively.
scoring_rule: Direction-aware, same convention as smith_math.py score: a SELL/STOP 'worked' if the price FELL after it; a BUY 'worked' if the price ROSE. +/-2.0% noise band = neutral. Report per-cohort hit rate, average signed benefit %, and total dollar impact. CRITICAL: report n alongside every accuracy figure -- none of these cohorts is large enough for a verdict at one week, and the honest output is a directional read plus the n, never a ranking presented as settled.
